topic: Optimizing ML-based QoS for Latency-Sensitive Traffic in Satellite Networks
consensus_response: By tailoring satellite orbital configurations to leverage the strengths of LEO and GEO satellites, we can significantly reduce propagation delays and optimize QoS for latency-sensitive traffic classes. This approach ensures that satellite networks can meet the growing demands of real-time applications and provide an excellent user experience.
reference_context: The discussion highlights the potential benefits of tailoring satellite orbital configurations to reduce propagation delays, improve capacity, and enhance QoS for latency-sensitive traffic classes. The use of machine learning algorithms for dynamic path optimization and real-time monitoring is a key aspect of this approach, ensuring that the best path is always chosen for each traffic flow based on real-time latency measurements.
